item.title: Governing Emerging Ocean Technologies for Climate Action: Marine Policy and International Regulation in the Age of AI and Spatial Computing
item.content:encoded:
This special issue addresses the governance challenges posed by emerging ocean technologies in the context of climate action. It focuses on how marine policies and international regulatory frameworks need to adapt to accommodate new technologies such as artificial intelligence and spatial computing that are being deployed in ocean-related applications.

The collection seeks contributions that examine the regulatory mechanisms, policy approaches, and international agreements necessary to manage these technological innovations while supporting climate-related ocean management objectives.

Appel publié par Marine Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
